mechanism_narrative: A sustained quarterly increase in GDPC1 (GDP growth) signals robust demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: GDPC1 growth reverses in the next quarter, or 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than a 5-year average (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in FEDFUNDS above 1.5% signals monetary tightening, compressing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, resulting in negative 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS remains above 1.5% for >6 months without a corresponding decline in 20d returns, or 20d returns are not significantly lower than a pre-tightening period (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous rise in FEDFUNDS (tightening) and decline in UNRATE (weaker labor market) creates conflicting signals, leading to negative 20-day returns as investors anticipate reduced growth and higher inflation.
regime_hint: monetary tightening and labor market weakening
failure_condition: 20d returns are not significantly negative when both proxies move as predicted, or the interaction effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05 in regression).

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, simultaneous high growth in GDPC1 (demand) and elevated INDPRO (supply) signals strong economic momentum, leading to positive 5-day forward returns.
failure_condition: In late-cycle periods, 5d returns are not significantly positive when both GDPC1 and INDPRO are above their 2017 baselines (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in UNRATE below 4% signals a strengthening labor market, boosting consumer confidence and corporate earnings, leading to positive 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: UNRATE decline reverses or 20d returns are not significantly higher than a 3-year average (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sudden drop in UNRATE below 3.5% triggers a surge in consumer spending and business investment, resulting in positive 5-day forward returns.
failure_condition: UNRATE remains below 3.5% for >3 months without 5d returns being significantly higher than baseline (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS rises (tightening) and HOUST (demand) falls, conflicting signals create uncertainty, leading to negative 20-day returns as investors anticipate reduced growth and higher rates.
failure_condition: 20d returns are not significantly negative when both proxies move as predicted, or the interaction effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In a post-shock recovery regime, both RSAFS (demand) and INDPRO (supply) exceeding pre-shock levels signal a rebound, driving positive 60-day returns as investors anticipate sustained growth.
failure_condition: In post-shock periods, 60d returns are not significantly positive when both RSAFS and INDPRO are above their 2017 baselines (p > 0.05).
